title: Jeff's Farm — EN/SN/PT (Zimbabwe Mbira Folk)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone alto duet 82bpm analog tape Shona English Portuguese language learning trilingual heritage
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Four in the morning, the rows already warm
Jeff walks the red dust before the day has form
Every worker knew his name, every name he knew
The boss who walked beside them, not above, but through

[Verse 2 — Shona (SN)]
Minda yake yakanga iriko red dust nguva yose [His farm was always in the red dust always]
Jill akanga achishanda kubva mangwanani [Jill was working from early morning]
Mombe dzose dzaiizwika mazita adzo [All the cows were known by their names]
Mhuri iyi yakavaka chimwe chinhu chikuru [This family built something great]

[Chorus — English]
Jeff's farm in the red dust dawn
Where the mbira plays and the morning moves on
Jill's hands in the dairy, Jeff's eyes on the rows
This is the farm that Kerri's family knows

[Bridge — Português]
Quando as chuvas chegaram eles mantiveram a linha [When the rains came they held the line]
Quando a seca chegou eles mantiveram a calma [When the dry came they held it fine]
Os trabalhadores ficaram porque o chefe era justo [The workers stayed because the boss was fair]
A fazenda permaneceu inteira porque todos estavam lá [The farm stayed whole because they all were there]

[Verse 3 — English]
They carried the farm to Australia in the end
Red dust in the memory, a different land to tend

[Outro — EN/SN/PT]
Jeff's farm
Minda yaJeff [Jeff's farm]
A fazenda de Jeff [Jeff's farm]
The red dust road
